# msexchangeonline_cross_tenant_partner (Resource)

Manages the Exchange capabilities (calendar availability, MailTips and calendar sharing) of the Microsoft 365 cross-tenant access policy of one partner tenant, through Microsoft Graph. The resource owns all the Exchange capabilities of the partner: one set outside Terraform shows in the plan and is removed. Other capabilities (profile card, Places) are never read nor changed. They take effect once the Microsoft Entra partner configuration and its Microsoft 365 collaboration trust exist.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `capabilities` (Attributes Set) The Exchange capabilities opened to the partner, one element per capability. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `partner_tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID of the partner organization. Changing it creates a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The partner tenant ID, in lowercase.

<a id="nestedatt--capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `capabilities`

Required:

- `allowed` (Boolean) Whether the partner's users can use the capability.
- `name` (String) The capability. Valid values: `crossTenantCalendarAvailabilityBasic`, `crossTenantCalendarAvailabilityLimitedDetails`, `crossTenantMailTipsAll`, `crossTenantMailTipsLimited`, `crossTenantCalendarSharingFreeBusySimple`, `crossTenantCalendarSharingFreeBusyDetail`, `crossTenantCalendarSharingFreeBusyReviewer`.

Optional:

- `excluded_groups` (Set of String) Object IDs of the groups whose members the capability never applies to.
- `excluded_users` (Set of String) Object IDs of the users the capability never applies to.
- `included_groups` (Set of String) Object IDs of the groups whose members the capability applies to. Without any included group or user, it applies to all users.
- `included_users` (Set of String) Object IDs of the users the capability applies to.
